about_the_game:
Forsaking Valhalla – Defend, Build, Survive

The gods have abandoned you. Your village stands alone, surrounded by relentless waves of mythological horrors. In Forsaking Valhalla, you must fortify your village, gather resources, and command your warriors to stand against the unending siege.

Will your village endure, or will it fall to the onslaught?

🛡️ Build & Defend

  • Construct walls, watchtowers, and strategic defenses to protect your Town Hall.

  • Upgrade structures with wood and stone to withstand stronger waves.

⚔️ Train Your Warriors

  • Use food and wood to recruit powerful units.

  • Adapt your strategy with a variety of Viking warriors, each with unique strengths.

🌲 Gather Resources & Manage Economy

  • Assign villagers to gather wood, stone, and food to expand your village.

  • Balance construction and unit training to survive increasingly difficult attacks.

🔥 Face Relentless Mythological Enemies

  • Battle legendary creatures inspired by Norse mythology.

  • Survive handcrafted waves, with endless challenges beyond wave 10.

🎯 How Long Can You Survive?

The longer you last, the harder the challenge becomes. Every decision matters. If your Town Hall falls, it's game over.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600XT
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770, 4GB or AMD Radeon R9 380, 4G
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K or AMD Ryzen 5 7600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070, 6GB or AMD Radeon RX Vega 56, 6G
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Forsaking Valhalla is a survival RTS where you defend your village against relentless waves of Norse mythological creatures. Build defenses, train warriors, and gather resources to survive as long as possible. If your Town Hall falls, it's game over. How long will you last?
